svg.title: A changed note is withheld
svg.desc: Four steps on one note. paracortex index stores its SHA-256 5961c595. You append a line, so the file on disk now hashes to 90d173e5. paracortex search re-hashes the note, sees the difference and withholds it with the reason 'changed since indexing'; the other passages are still delivered. After paracortex index runs again, the note is delivered with hash 90d173e5.
